user.title: Configure Codex Provider
user.description: Supply your own OAuth client identity. Initial setup and identity changes require ChatGPT device authorization. Model-only changes reuse your existing credentials. The model must support HTTP/SSE Codex Responses.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to ChatGPT again
reauth_confirm.description: Review your client identity and authorize a new device code.

progress.authorize: Open [{url}]({url}) and enter **{code}** to sign in to ChatGPT. Waiting for approval (up to 10 minutes). Cancel this dialog to stop polling.

error.invalid_identity: Supply non-empty ASCII identity values without leading/trailing whitespace or control characters.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to contact the provider. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_response: The provider returned an unexpected response. Check the supported model and report persistent failures.
error.invalid_auth: The provider rejected authorization. Check your client identity and sign in again.
error.access_denied: Authorization was denied. Start again to sign in.
error.login_expired: Device authorization expired. Start again to receive a new code.
